For the marketplace listing: the things that typically accelerate the process are:
1) Completed product listing metadata (screenshots, short/long descriptions, contact info)
2) Contactable customer reference or pilot agreement (if available)
3) Completed security attestation or SOC 2 statement (if requested by AWS review)
4) Signed reseller/partner agreement (if you plan to list under our ISV program)

If Nexera can provide the basic metadata and the MAP you shared, Marketplace Enablement can give a target lead time (usually 4–6 weeks once metadata and legal are in order). I’ll loop in Marketplace Enablement for the checklist and an invite template.
